technology_name: QUALITATIVE METHOD FOR SELF-HEALING OF PROPAGATING VOLTAGE DISTURBANCES IN POWER GRIDS PROLIFERATED WITH CONVERTER-INTERFACED RESOURCES
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: The proliferation of converter-interfaced renewable resources creates complex, fast-propagating voltage disturbances that legacy grid protections fail to detect or isolate in real time.
description: A self-healing system for a bulk electrical power grid containing a master processing module, local computing units, and communication interfaces configured to detect, monitor, and mitigate voltage anomalies via a multi-tiered coordinated resource execution architecture.
applications: Smart grid distribution automation, renewable energy power plant integration, substation protection management, and microgrid control networks.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
